title: jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile
why_read: A reverse-engineered compatibility layer bringing Diablo II: Resurrected to iOS/macOS natively, interesting as a feat of systems/platform engineering even if legally gray.
analysis: This project is a compatibility layer that lets players run their own copy of Diablo II: Resurrected on iPhone, iPad, and Mac without an official port, requiring users to supply their own game files. Technically it's notable because getting a modern Windows game engine with full touch controls and 60fps running natively on Apple's mobile platforms is a serious reverse-engineering and porting effort. It sits in a legal gray zone since it's an unofficial compatibility layer for a commercial game, though it explicitly requires owning the original files rather than distributing copyrighted assets.
